Generated from the clap definition of the `modelspec` command line in [`crates/modelspec-cli/src/lib.rs`](https://github.com/beyond10x/modelspec/blob/main/crates/modelspec-cli/src/lib.rs) by `modelspec-docs`. It lists only commands that exist.

> Compile, check and train .mspec models

`modelspec --version` prints its version, and `--help` after any command prints the text below.

## Exit status

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `0` | success |
| `1` | diagnostics or a runtime error |
| `2` | a usage error |

## Commands

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`modelspec check`](#modelspec-check) | Parse and type-check a `.mspec` file |
| [`modelspec ir`](#modelspec-ir) | Print the IR of a `.mspec` file at a stage |
| [`modelspec train`](#modelspec-train) | Train a `.mspec` model |

## `modelspec check`

Parse and type-check a `.mspec` file

```text
Usage: modelspec check <PATH>
```

Every argument is required and has no default.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `<PATH>` | The .mspec file to check. |

## `modelspec ir`

Print the IR of a `.mspec` file at a stage

```text
Usage: modelspec ir --stage <STAGE> <PATH>
```

Every argument is required and has no default.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `<PATH>` | The .mspec file to lower. |
| `--stage <STAGE>` | The IR level to print. One of:<br/>`tensor`: Tensor IR after lowering and dead-code elimination<br/>`training`: Training IR: the Tensor IR with its reverse pass and SGD step attached |

## `modelspec train`

Train a `.mspec` model

```text
Usage: modelspec train --backend <BACKEND> <PATH>
```

Every argument is required and has no default.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `<PATH>` | The .mspec file to train. |
| `--backend <BACKEND>` | The backend that runs the training step. One of:<br/>`cpu`: The CPU interpreter<br/>`vulkan`: Vulkan compute: not available in M0 |
